name: ae.projectory/mcp
title: Projectory
description: Find UAE off-plan developments, registered residential sales and research reports.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Find published off-plan UAE developments by project name or slug text, combined with exact structured filters. Returns shortlist facts and a pagination cursor. Follow more pages only when the user's task needs them; a page's result count is not a total.

Use `suggest_project_terms` for a partial facet name, `list_project_facets` to explore all filter choices, and `fetch` for selected project detail. A known project URL or slug can go straight to `fetch`.

Prices and price filters apply to the whole development. They do not establish that a particular bedroom count, property type, or unit is available at that price.

query.description: Literal text within a project name or slug; ASCII letter case is ignored. Use structured filters for location, budget and other criteria; this does not interpret natural-language requests.

emirate.description: Exact public API emirate slug from list_project_facets, for example dubai.

developer.description: Exact public API developer slug from list_project_facets, for example sobha-realty.

area.description: Exact public API area slug from list_project_facets, for example dubai-marina.

propertyType.description: Exact public API property type slug from list_project_facets, for example apartment.

bedroomsMin.description: Return developments advertising a bedroom count at or above this value. Zero leaves the filter unset; it does not select studios or identify a unit at a particular price.

priceMinAed.description: Lower bound of the desired development-wide price interval. A development matches when its known range reaches this amount or above; unknown pricing is excluded.

priceMaxAed.description: Upper bound of the desired development-wide price interval. A development matches when its known range starts at or below this amount; unknown pricing is excluded.

newLaunch.description: Filter for projects marked as new launches.

comingSoon.description: Filter for projects marked as coming soon.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous search call.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description:
Search canonical residential sale registrations in one required market: Dubai or Abu Dhabi. Whole area, project and building names ignore ASCII letter case; provider IDs match exactly. Filters combine with AND; date bounds are inclusive. Returns newest-first pages of 25 rows by default, at most 100. Follow `nextCursor` with the same filters only when more rows are needed for the user's task. A page's row count is not the total number of matching sales.

A bedroom count matches the canonical range; 0 means studio. `sourceProjectId` is a provider identifier, not a Projectory development ID. Partial-name discovery, totals and statistics are not provided. Results do not guarantee real-time freshness.

areaName.description: Whole canonical area name; ASCII letter case is ignored.

projectName.description: Whole canonical project name; ASCII letter case is ignored.

buildingName.description: Whole canonical building name; ASCII letter case is ignored.

sourceProjectId.description: Exact provider project identifier. This is not a Projectory development ID.

from.description: Inclusive sale-registration date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; year 1900 to 2200.

to.description: Inclusive sale-registration date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format; year 1900 to 2200.

bedrooms.description: Bedroom count to match against each transaction's canonical bedroom range. Use 0 for a studio.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous transaction search page. Reuse the same filters when continuing.

tools.name: list_research_reports
tools.description:
List citable Projectory Research reports, newest first. Reports analyse registered residential sales from Dubai Land Department (DLD) and Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre (ADREC) transaction records. Each report has a canonical `url` to cite and usually a downloadable `dataset` with its citation, temporal coverage and licence.

`market` dubai returns DLD-based reports and abu-dhabi returns ADREC-based reports; combined reports match both. Returns 10 reports by default, at most 50; there is no pagination. Reports are informational, not financial or investment advice.

period.description: Return reports covering this reporting period.

limit.description: Maximum reports to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Fetch one development's detail using a known ID, slug or Projectory URL; no prior search or facet lookup is needed. Returns development-wide pricing, location, availability, enquiry action, payment plan, grouped unit types, evidence, media and a plain-text description marked as untrusted source material. Individual unit rows and raw HTML are omitted.

Accepted forms: `project:jacob-co-beachfront-living`, `jacob-co-beachfront-living`, or `https://projectory.ae/projects/jacob-co-beachfront-living/`. Use `search` if only the project name is known.

id.description: Project ID from search, plain slug, or public Projectory project URL.

tools.name: list_project_facets
tools.description: Explore all exact values for `emirate`, `area`, `developer`, `propertyType`, `availability` and `sort`, plus boolean flags `newLaunch` and `comingSoon`. Skip this call when the needed slugs are known. Use `suggest_project_terms` for a single partial facet name instead of downloading all choices.

tools.name: suggest_project_terms
tools.description: Resolve partial emirate, area, developer or property-type text, such as "marina" or "sobha", into exact filter slugs for `search`. Does not search project names. Skip when the exact slug is known; use `list_project_facets` to enumerate all values.

query.description: Partial developer, area, emirate, or property-type text.
